frozen_release_verification.method: Read-only verify_v2: complete manifest/model file inventory and exact runtime/architecture/threshold pins. No calls parsed, model loaded, or inference performed.

contract_review.evidence: validate_audit revalidates FULL, exact V2 files/runtime, source call bytes and observed adjacency; reconstructs entire envelope and compares canonical digest. Covers complete FULL digest, original/current/prior input digests, effective intervention inputs, exact ordered indices, skip records, heads, states, limits and authority. Extra/missing/reordered/foreign rows and substitutions are rejected. Builder records artifact byte hashes and checks them around the model call.

UNAVAILABLE rejects all retained partial NO_CONTEXT heads, known reasons only. Prior-present enabled heads become UNAVAILABLE; no-prior rows become NOT_APPLICABLE; disabled heads remain DISABLED. Builder accepts a validated unavailable envelope but explicitly says no agreement was established. Invalid companion audit is deleted while validated FULL stays ready.

contract_review.topic: Shared budget and actual FULL versus NO_CONTEXT
contract_review.evidence: One CPU model, two threads, same <=60-second monotonic deadline from before startup. FULL uses no_context=False; NO_CONTEXT uses True only on prior-present rows; no_tail=False in both. Frozen runtime zeros only prior features and retains current mean/tail. Parent child bounds monotonic and wall time and kills owned process tree. Finite input limits reject overflow without partial results.

contract_review.topic: Disabled consent heads and bank authority
contract_review.evidence: current_affirm/current_withdraw thresholds fixed at 1.01; DISABLED regardless of raw probability shifts. Exact authority is false and financial authorization UNKNOWN in FULL, audit and notices. Agreement is only a proposal; negative selection is not semantic denial. No identity/consent/bank-action qualification is asserted.

Off branches return before file/model work; V1 still invokes finetuned_assist.py without audit arguments and retains existing FULL schema. Missing releases package as an empty optional list. Legacy one-turn adjacency and explicit V2 two-turn adjacency pass tests. Audit import is stdlib-only. No Git historical comparison or real legacy model execution was performed.

blockers.classification: Submission provenance blocker; not a bank bypass or a defect in validate_audit
blockers.title: Packager accepts invalid audit and stale trace bindings
blockers.trigger: A run satisfies published/completed/export prerequisites but its stored context audit has foreign source indices, claimed bank authority, and invalid/missing FULL/request bindings; trace artifact hash differs from audit bytes.
blockers.reproduction: Disposable synthetic run, real package.main, patched ROOT/KIT/argv only, no model releases or network. Foreign row 999/999, bank_authority=true, financial_authorization=APPROVED, FULL/request empty objects, trace artifact_sha256 zeroes. Packaging succeeded and archive hashed the invalid audit anew.
blockers.impact: A fresh archive checksum proves packaged bytes only; it does not preserve the builder's previously validated source/FULL/audit relationship. A post-run damaged or replaced audit can enter a reviewable submission without rejection.
blockers.suggested_owner_action: Cicero: before collecting payload bytes, validate stored request/FULL/audit for every selected/provenance run containing audit evidence, bind actual archived calls/model/runtime and compare recorded builder artifact hashes. Resolve relocated request paths explicitly while retaining original request digest/provenance. Fail on invalid companions; retain explicit unavailable/no-audit classic behavior.

blockers.classification: Windows archive manifest binding blocker; pre-existing generic packaging path issue
blockers.title: Manifest paths differ from ZIP entry names on Windows
blockers.trigger: str(relative_to(...)) emits backslashes for nested paths; ZipInfo normalizes those separators to forward slashes while manifest retains the original string.
blockers.reproduction: Same synthetic packaging fixture: manifest path competition/runs/synthetic/work\finetuned-context-evidence.json; ZIP path competition/runs/synthetic/work/finetuned-context-evidence.json. Two manifest paths were absent verbatim from archive.namelist().
blockers.impact: A verifier using manifest path exactly cannot locate the audit or FULL evidence to check their hashes.
blockers.suggested_owner_action: Cicero: use relative_to(...).as_posix() consistently for every archive path; assert each manifest path exists exactly once in the ZIP and its digest matches.

nonblocking_limitations: A parent hard timeout during NO_CONTEXT or final validation discards the paired output, including FULL; optional mode falls back unavailable. This loses diagnostic availability but supplies no false agreement. Source-derived, not reproduced with real inference.

Canonical hashes are integrity bindings, not proof of raw speech or authentic model computation. Internally consistent fabricated logits cannot be disproved by this envelope alone; module documents this boundary.

No candidate workflows, real failed-call artifacts, existing workflow outputs, live Freya data, or parent's new result file were read. Actual public-kernel comparison and candidate packaging remain parent-owned.
